具体对应关系可在模拟中查看本装备天赋栏
enEffect: Equipped Operator gains an additional Alliance determined by the other piece of Equipment they carry
enUpgraded: N/A

cnEffect: 【基础&进阶】每次攻击或治疗时攻击速度+2（最高60层）；若与“动能单手弩”同时持有则组合为“动能轰击弩”
enEffect: Each attack or heal grants +2 ASPD (up to 60 stacks); if held together with "Kinetic Hand Crossbow", combines into "Kinetic Bombardment Crossbow"
enUpgraded: N/A

cnEffect: 【基础&进阶】攻击力+30%，攻击速度+30，每秒流失1%最大生命值（不会降至0）；若与“汲取者之喙”同时持有则组合为“汲取者之镰”
enEffect: ATK +30%, ASPD +30, loses 1% Max HP per second (cannot fall to 0); if held together with "Siphoner's Beak", combines into "Siphoner's Scythe"
enUpgraded: N/A

s2Note: Replaces S2's Steam Heart as the Tier VI Victoria hammer capstone.
cnEffect: 【基础&进阶】携带者获得当前场上所有维式重锤特殊效果，且每有一种带有特殊效果的维式重锤自身攻击力额外+20%
enEffect: Equipped Operator gains the special effects of all Victorian Hammers currently on the field, and gains an additional +20% ATK for each type of special-effect Victorian Hammer present
enUpgraded: N/A

cnEffect: 【基础&进阶】免疫晕眩、冻结等特殊状态，阻挡数+2，每阻挡一个单位自身生命上限和防御力提升20%；携带者开启技能时对自身周围范围内敌人产生一次诱导，持续3秒
enEffect: Immune to Stun, Frozen, and other abnormal statuses; Block +2; for each unit blocked, Max HP and DEF increase by +20%; when the equipped Operator activates a skill, Lures enemies in surrounding range for 3 seconds
enUpgraded: N/A

cnEffect: 【基础&进阶】造成伤害时有30%概率使攻击力提升至130%；每次攻击后攻击速度+2（最高60层），攻击速度叠加达到上限后每次攻击时有30%概率对攻击范围内随机敌人造成自身攻击力100%的范围物理伤害
enEffect: Dealing damage has a 30% chance to increase ATK to 130%; each attack grants +2 ASPD (up to 60 stacks), and once ASPD stacks reach the cap, each attack has a 30% chance to deal 100% of ATK as AoE Physical damage to a random enemy within Attack Range
enUpgraded: N/A

cnEffect: 【基础&进阶】攻击力+30%，攻击速度+30，每秒流失1%最大生命值（不会降至0），每次造成伤害时回复相当于造成伤害5%的生命值；携带者处于技能期间时上述效果翻倍且自身无法被治疗
enEffect: ATK +30%, ASPD +30, loses 1% Max HP per second (cannot fall to 0), and recovers HP equal to 5% of damage dealt whenever dealing damage; while the equipped Operator's skill is active, all of the above effects are doubled and the Operator cannot be healed
enUpgraded: N/A

cnEffect: 【基础&进阶】携带者攻击范围内的敌人受到的晕眩、冻结、恐惧等异常状态影响时间提高100%，且对受这类异常状态影响的敌人造成伤害提升30%；携带者处于技能期间时，每次施加这类异常状态时有50%概率将其传递给附近另一名敌人
enEffect: Duration of Stun, Frozen, Fear, and other abnormal statuses on enemies within the equipped Operator's Attack Range increases by +100%, and damage dealt to enemies affected by such statuses increases by +30%; while the equipped Operator's skill is active, each time they inflict such an abnormal status, there is a 50% chance to spread it to another nearby enemy
enUpgraded: N/A

cnEffect: 【基础&进阶】生命上限+60%，每秒恢复8%最大生命值；攻击力+50%，造成伤害时额外造成攻击力30%真实伤害
enEffect: Max HP +60%, recovers 8% Max HP per second; ATK +50%, and dealing damage deals an additional 30% of ATK as True damage
enUpgraded: N/A
